cars.specification_market: D3 / Typ 4E S8 5.2 FSI quattro, February 2006 German-market technical-sheet reference. Native 331 kW at 7000 rpm and 540 Nm at 3500 rpm are retained; the sheet’s parenthetical 450 is not relabelled as mechanical bhp or converted. Its governed 250 km/h and 5.1-second 0–100 km/h are manufacturer figures, not independently measured tests. Selected specification includes conventional ventilated disc brakes; optional ceramics are not implied. Earlier D2 V8, later turbo-V8 S8s, Gallardo engine specifications and facelift equipment are excluded. Count this D3 road family once across years, trim and equipment.
cars.summary: The D3 S8 combines a high-revving, direct-injection V10 with an aluminium space-frame saloon and permanent quattro drive. This distinctive ten-cylinder flagship belongs to the era of naturally aspirated performance saloons, with substantially different engineering from the original V8 S8.

cars.generation: Second-generation F5 / B9 biturbo-V6 RS 5 production-road family
cars.variant: Original 2.9 TFSI quattro Coupe — July 2017 Swiss introduction
cars.specification_market: Original second-generation F5 / B9 RS 5 Coupe, July 2017 Swiss launch reference. The contemporary importer release explicitly calls it the second generation. Retain native 331 kW and 600 Nm; 450 PS is not mechanical bhp. Select standard 250 km/h specification; the optional RS dynamic package permits 280 km/h but is not assumed fitted. Optional rear sport differential, DRC, carbon roof, ceramic brakes and dynamic steering are not standard specification. The declared 3.9-second 0–100 km/h is a factory claim. No 2020 facelift, Sportback, ABT conversion or current hybrid RS 5 field is imported. Count this generation once across bodies, packages and years.
cars.summary: The second RS 5 generation replaced the original high-revving V8 formula with a compact twin-turbo V6, rear-biased quattro and a new chassis. It is a substantive evolution of Audi Sport’s performance coupe, combining hot-V turbo packaging with five-link suspension rather than merely a cosmetic or yearly update.
